_: Biomes O' Plenty, from ATM6's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. The sandstones' slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules.

Stone: orange sandstone and dried salt are natural rock of the lush desert and the wasteland, as vanilla sandstone is, and the rules leave them out for a decorative word or no stone word; so are black and white sandstone, which this census did not judge, named as 1.20.1's file and the 26.x files have them, so the editions match (W4 R14, 2026-11-13). Flesh is the floor of the visceral heap, the block the flesh family was made for (W4 T17), on a sponge material no rule reads.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.16.5 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
